parts:
Here are the dependent branches and the stan-dev/math pull request:

stan-dev/stan branch:
feature/2072-cpp11-math-h-namespaces

stan-dev/math branch:
feature/0370-cp11-cmath-funs-2

stan-dev/math pull request:
https://github.com/stan-dev/math/pull/395

The stan-dev/math pull request is fine other than for the upstream
integration test. Can I run that locally without exploding my computer
with the stan-dev/stan branch I have in place?

I'm not sure what the complete set of tests are that I need to run
locally for stan-dev/stan to make sure everything works.

- Bob

Hi Bob,

I checked out the Stan branch and updated the math branch and it passes all tests.

You can run it locally. From the Stan branch, you can either add a make variable that points to the folder or update the submodule.

The tests I ran:
./runTests.py src/test/integration 
./runTests.py src/test/performance 
./runTests.py src/test/unit

I'm reviewing your pull request now.


Daniel
